encode_string_to_characters: encode a string into space-separated characters using the Characters BPE encoder
decode_characters_to_string: decode space-separated characters back into the original string using the Characters decoder
register_characters_bpe: register the Characters class as a BPE encoder with the name characters in fairseq
review_characters_encode: review the Characters encode method that escapes spaces and joins individual characters
review_characters_decode: review the Characters decode method that removes spaces and restores escaped space characters
